title: Execution feedback from public tests as an allocation signal

budget.axis: samples k in 1..10, sequential with early stop
budget.charged: exact tokenizer count over published generations

metric: pass-within-k at matched realised inference cost; primary = Governor minus the randomised fixed envelope at the Governor's own cost
notes: Execution feedback GENERATED by running each candidate against public_test_cases in a sandbox. LiveCodeBench's published metadata was forbidden: its emptiness is exactly the label (1530 empty/PASS, 2470 non-empty/FAIL, zero off-diagonal). private_test_cases never read.
